title: A rep whose switch is turned off stays and reads (Inactive)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active staff member for this test at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep B.
  • After sales rep B was picked on the work order, turn sales rep B's "Sales Representative" switch off and save (the staff account stays active).
  • Open the Work Orders page in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field.
  3. Click on an empty part of the page to close the dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Sales Representative field reads sales rep B's name followed by "(Inactive)".

Step 2:

  • Sales rep B is not in the dropdown.
  • No option is checked.

Step 3:

  • The field still reads sales rep B's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Nothing changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-E2: “A person whose Sales Representative switch was turned off, or whose staff account was deactivated, stays in the field until someone changes it. The field reads their name followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)". They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”
